messages:
alex liu: Heads up — queue for rtx-a100-resv is 18 days out. Need 8 GPUs for payment-processing pipeline. Blocker for release tomorrow. Anyone can escalate? @maria gonzalez
maria gonzalez: On it. What's the reservation ID or workspace?
alex liu: No reservation yet. We tried spot-to-reserved today but got 429. Billing flagged a commit shortfall, possibly why holdlist occurred.
sanjay rao: I can check billing. Account 4521 shows committed usage not applied because of invoice sync error. Filing ticket BILL-23456.
infra-bot: Reservation system alert: pool rtx-a100-eu low capacity. Holdlist count=27. ETA: 17-21 days.
jessica (oncall): We can temp scale to gpus in us-east with cross-region routing, but latency for eu users increases. For load test ok?
alex liu: Production traffic is eu-heavy — 200ms p90 tolerance. Cross-region not ideal.
maria gonzalez: Two options: 1) push a small canary with CPU fallback for batch jobs, 2) approve a short-term committed burst in EU region. @ops-manager, any leeway in committed capacity budget?
ops-manager: We can approve a short-term committed burst for up to 12 GPUs for 7 days, but that'll add ~ $18k. Approve?
alex liu: Approve. Please prioritize eu region. Also need reservation ID returned ASAP.
sanjay rao: Billing ticket created: BILL-23456. Marking as high priority. Syncing with cloud sales to push capacity forward.
infra-bot: Reservation request submitted: REQ-7788. Status: queued. Estimated fulfillment 14 days unless billing override applied.
maria gonzalez: I'll ping partner rep at cloud: juli@cloudvendor.com and add 'release-critical' tag to the request.
ops-manager: :thumbsup: go ahead.
alex liu: Thanks. If we get any 'capacity transfer' option, prefer migrating existing small batch to bf16 quantized model to reduce GPU count.
jessica (oncall): I'll prepare rollback plan. Will post steps + runbook in #eng-infra shortly.
sanjay rao: Update: Cloud rep replied, can prioritize if billing ticket references BILL-23456 and we commit to the burst spend. They've asked for PO by EOD.
maria gonzalez: PO in progress. I'll attach to the cloud ticket and ping sales.
alex liu: Great. Keep thread updated. Potential follow-up: add auto-alert when holdlist > 10 and 'release-critical' tag added.
